Features — Wayback Machine

  • Instant Access: One-click access to 801 billion+ archived web pages from 1996 to present.
  • Historical Research: See how websites looked and evolved over time. Perfect for research and nostalgia.
  • Dead Link Recovery: Access content from pages that no longer exist or have been moved.
  • Universal Coverage: Works on any website with archived snapshots available.

Use Cases - Time Travel

🔍 Historical Research

Researchers, journalists, and historians can track how websites and content changed over time.

🔗 Dead Link Recovery

Access content from broken or removed links. Find archived versions of pages that no longer exist.

🎨 Web Design Inspiration

See how popular websites looked in the past. Track design trends and evolution of web interfaces.

3-Second Install, Use Forever

1

Press and Hold Button

Click and hold the brown 'Wayback' button.

2

Drag to Bookmarks Bar

Wayback

Crucial Step: Drag the button to your browser's 'Bookmarks Bar' or 'Favorites Bar', then release the mouse.

3

Done! Click to View History

On any page, click this bookmark to view its archived history on Wayback Machine.
